title: Fifteenth stale-suite triage draw, filed under P3 item 26: ranks 1-20 of the verdict-aware ranking, 20 directories, 20 drawn files, each executed, verdicts only
idNote: Recorded under the standing P3 item 26 rather than a new T id: T-400..T-599 and T-700..T-799 are exhausted and the T-800+ range is an owner decision. Precedent: item 26 draw 7, 2026-09-24.

scope.drawnFrom: governedRiskRanking ranks 1-20 of docs/architecture/test-ci-coverage-census.json on the base, first drawable path of each directory. 0 critical and 0 high remain, so all 20 are band unclassified.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci --json on the base. Counts are what jest reported, never read from the census.
scope.reachability: Every subject was resolved from the test's imports and checked against docs/architecture/unreachable-components.json (orphans) and docs/architecture/orphaned-lib-modules.json (testOnly). A held row names the registry entry that holds it.
scope.readOnly: No workflow, baseline or test file is changed by this record. The census is regenerated so the 20 files are held out of the next draw with their verdicts published.

secondHalf.what: Wire the wire_into_ci rows (by named file where the directory is partly covered), apply the WorkspaceExplorer label update and wire it, rewrite the toolUseLoop byte scan as behaviour and wire it. The six T-775 rows stay held until their owner acts.
secondHalf.reExecuteFirst: Re-execute every row on the then-current main before wiring; this record is a snapshot at its base.

suites.rationale: Red 1 of 2. The case expects the display name 'Healthcare Demo'; demoSafeClientText now maps the input fixture name to its DEMO_SAFE_CLIENT_NAMES entry (src/lib/client-config.ts, changed 2026-08-07), which no longer reads 'Healthcare Demo', so the expectation is stale. Not repaired and not wired: TenantIdentityStrip is listed in unreachable-components.json and no non-test file imports it, so a repaired suite would count coverage over a component no route reaches. Retire-or-mount is T-775's rule; if it is mounted, update the expectation with this reason before wiring.

Red 1 of 6. The table case expects getByText("Incumbent contract") as an exact match; the canonical requirement EVID-SRC-STR-INCUMBENT was relabelled 'Incumbent contract package' on 2026-08-07 (commit 0db2bd97a5, 'Expand Source evidence intake contract'), and WorkspaceExplorer renders the canonical label. The behaviour under test (strategy step surfaces its canonical requirements) is unchanged; the literal is stale. Subject is mounted by three routes (source event workspace, strategic-moves workspace, setup files). Update the one expectation, preferably by reading the label from evidenceForStage('strategy'), then wire.
Green 5 of 5, behavioural over CANONICAL_TENANTS (15 product importers), reads no repository file. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

Green 4 of 4, behavioural cross-check of the fixture rosters under src/data/apexretail; the modules are reached through src/lib/knowledge/enterprise-data-room.ts (agent-context-broker). interviews.ts itself has no product importer; it sits under src/data, which the orphan report does not watch. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

Green 2 of 2, behavioural, but its subject is listed testOnly in orphaned-lib-modules.json: only this test reaches it. Wiring it records coverage over code no entry point runs. Retire-or-mount under T-775's rule.

Green 13 of 13, behavioural, but the harness module is listed testOnly in orphaned-lib-modules.json. A safety harness that nothing runs except its own suite proves nothing about a product path; whoever decides retire-or-mount should first check whether a live answer path was meant to call it. Held under T-775's rule.
Green 7 of 7, behavioural over all-agent-doctrine.ts, which /api/chat/agent and /api/tower/ask import. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

Green 9 of 9, behavioural over cxo-answer-quality.ts, reached by the agent-grounding scorer and the QA live runner; not in orphaned-lib-modules.json. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

Green 1 of 1, but the only case reads src/lib/agent/streaming/toolUseLoop.ts with fs.readFileSync and asserts two source literals (the initialToolChoice parameter type and the turn===1 spread). That passes on a comment containing the text and fails on a reflow. The subject is a live control (explicit tool_choice only on the first model turn): rewrite as behaviour by driving the loop with a mocked Anthropic stream and asserting tool_choice is present in the turn-1 request and absent from turn 2, then wire.

Green 15 of 15, behavioural over document-generation-policy.ts, imported by deliverables generate and the orchestrator model caller. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.
Green 5 of 5, behavioural over shared-response-shaper.ts, reached via agent response-contract and response-shape. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

Green 6 of 6, behavioural over the initiative-deep ai-initiatives join with a mocked client; not in orphaned-lib-modules.json. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.
Green 4 of 4, behavioural over azure-connectivity/config.ts, imported by /api/health/azure-connectivity. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.

A screening control nobody calls is a retire-or-mount decision, not a wiring task. Held under T-775's rule.

Green 27 of 27, behavioural over freshness-model.ts (6 product importers including EvidenceTraceDrawer and the Source decision queue read adapter). Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only; wiring is item 26's next draw half.
